name: chunked_embedding_lora_a
description: Chunked LoRA-A embedding gather with signature chunked_embedding_lora_a(input_ids, weights, batch_info, vocab_size). input_ids is [S] integer token ids, weights is [num_loras, rank, vocab_size], and batch_info supplies seg_indptr [bs+1], weight_indices [bs], lora_ranks [num_loras] and a permutation mapping source positions to output rows. For each batch segment b, let rows = permutation[seg_indptr[b]:seg_indptr[b+1]] and r = lora_ranks[weight_indices[b]]; write out[rows, :r] = weights[weight_indices[b], :r, input_ids[rows]].T and leave remaining rank columns zero. Return a newly allocated [S, rank] tensor of weights dtype. No input is modified. The suite exercises bfloat16 weights, identity and shuffled permutations, ranks 16/32/64 and vocabularies up to 128256.
